page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute-oriented instance powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.7 GHz under the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No dedicated accelerators or GPUs are included with this configuration.

Network interfaces on the instance provide a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. Local storage is not bundled with this configuration, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system files and persistent data. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio emphasizes processor density over large working memory sets. From a resource allocation perspective, provisioning 2.0 GB per core avoids unneeded memory overhead for operations constrained primarily by CPU execution cycles. Workloads requiring large in-memory caches or fast local ephemeral disk IOPS face tradeoffs due to the lack of bundled local disks and moderate memory capacity.

Appropriate deployment targets include compute-bound processing tasks, web serving clusters, batch processing, continuous integration pipelines, and stateless application layers dependent on remote data stores.
